resources: No new resources or native hooks beyond the prior bridge stage. Public heading measurement is out-of-combat presentation work; combat timer election remains alpha-only. Native timer justification and saved title/timer/control geometry restore on release.
nativeStatus: Pending fresh native capture, actual text clipping/click geometry and combat/taint checks. Child performed no native input/settings/profiler actions.
